items.quote: Das Guthaben überweise ich Ihnen in den nächsten Tagen auf Ihr bekanntes Konto.
items.computation: The statement sets a credit (Guthaben) of EUR 66,00 in the tenant's favour (EUR 1.074,00 allocated costs minus EUR 1.140,00 prepayments). The landlord promises to transfer it 'in den nächsten Tagen' (in the next few days) after the statement was handed over on 20.11.2026. This is not a fixed calendar date nor a legally defined period (no statutory deadline governs the timing of a credit repayment under §556 BGB, only the landlord's deadline to issue the statement itself), so no exact, legally certain due date can be derived from the wording alone. The earliest plausible reading would put it within roughly one to two weeks of 20.11.2026, but this is an estimate, not a computed deadline.
